title: A narrowing coil saved by SciForge before the 2026-10-11 fixes (its mirror image) is rebuilt right when the file is opened

steps.comment: as saved before the fixes: FreeCAD's helix with the negative angle, the mirror image below the plane
opening the file rebuilds the coil with today's code (a log line says so)

expect.note: The same coil as sf_coil_taper_narrow once rebuilt on opening: Circle d2 inside d20: its centre at r 9 on the plane, 9 - 20 tan 10 at the top; Pappus with the mean radius 9 - 10 tan 10: V = pi x 2 pi x 4 x (9 - 10 tan 10). FreeCAD's helix only widens away from its section (a negative angle gave the mirror image below the plane): SciForge sweeps it from the narrow end. The helix is an approximation, hence rel_tol 1e-4.
